strings.en: The colony...!?
What's wrong, Captain? You've gone white.
Gimme a break! Didn't we already clear up all the trouble!?
So I thought... but a colony... is heading for the moon...!
Don't tell me... Captain, is it the colony that went missing!?
Yes... But I can't see their aim... Why the moon?
Von Braun, Anaheim Electronics...
There are key facilities there, sure... but why so suddenly!?
This is no time to deliberate! We have to hurry...!
...So, the Nadesico will set course for the moon right away too.
Londo Bell sure is busy, huh?
No rest for the poor...
With no other fleet free to move, I guess it can't be helped...
Captain Bright's got it rough... Huh? Prospector, where were you?
Urgent word from HQ... The Nadesico is to descend to Earth.
To Earth? But a colony's about to drop on the moon...
This is also a request from the Federation Forces on the ground.
...From Admiral Misumaru himself.
Father? ...Jeez, he could just contact me directly instead of via Nergal.
Maybe talking to his cute daughter at work embarrasses him?
Apparently it's out of consideration, so Londo Bell and the Gandor Team
won't worry needlessly about this mission...
Hmm... Well, whatever.
So what's this job they want the Nadesico specifically to do?
The data has been entered into Omoikane. Hoshino...
Yes... The other day, from a Tulip dropped on Russia,
a giant Jovian Lizard weapon emerged.
The Nadesico is to hurry there and destroy it... That's all.
I see... The Gandor Team has its hands full retaking Jaburo...
so the Jovian Lizards are left to the Nadesico, is that it?
Headquarters also seems to see it as a good chance to show off
what the Nadesico can do alone.
Who cares what the reason is! The Jovian Lizards' mechs showed up,
and we're the only ones who can wreck 'em right now, right?
If that doesn't fire you up, you ain't a man!
You're burning way too hot, Yamada.
Making moe books that sell hot is tough, y'know.
That's a totally different word. ...Anyway, setting that aside...
Yurika, what'll we do? The moon or Earth...
......The Nadesico will descend to Earth.
Akito... I think we should do the job only we can do.
Shouldn't you be telling Captain Bright, not Akito!?
Ugh... R-Right, Megumi. Please open a channel to the Ra Cailum.
So the Nadesico's gone...
I didn't think we were relying on their strength...
but splitting our forces now hurts...
What's going on, Captain Bright...? An emergency muster?
...Is everyone here?
The Ra Cailum is going to stop the colony heading for the moon!
Heading for the moon... Is it bad if a colony gets near the moon?
It seems "heading for" was putting it mildly.
Zeon is trying to drop a colony on the moon. We must stop it.
A colony drop on the moon!? What're those Zeon guys thinking!?
No kidding. What a stupid stunt.
But the moon... we just fought Vega and Zeon there, didn't we?
Not long ago... in that lunar city, Von Braun or whatever,
we fought the Vega crowd.
What could be there, I wonder?
Have they given up on Earth and gone for the moon...?
I can't believe they'd fixate on the moon for no reason...
Come to think of it, Duke was bothered by it too...
Huh? Oh, you mean the Vega Star Federation?
...Their goal should be Earth. So why were they fixated on the moon...?
Yeah... Even Gil Berg comes down to Earth pretty often...
The Vega Star Federation could attack Earth directly too...
There's gotta be something to it.
Forget what Vega's scheming. The moon's the problem right now!
The captain said we're off to Von Braun again... Intercept first, right?
Intercept, huh...
Can a thing like that even be shot down...?
If we just need to turn it, smash the mirrors or something,
and won't its orbit shift?
If we throw the colony's rotation off balance... it's possible.
Well, good thing it's still close by.
Once we hit Von Braun, we sortie right away.
Don't we even have time for a little shopping?
Let's give up on that.
Besides, it'd be a pain if a colony fell on us mid-haggle, right?
...So you haggle.
Captain Bright. Looked like you were talking with the Nadesico girl.
Planning for once we reach the moon?
Hm... Right, I haven't told you yet.
The Nadesico is descending to Earth for an urgent mission in Russia.
We'll carry out the moon operation on our own.
A mission on the ground... What's the Gandor Team doing?
The Gandor Team has its hands full with the attack on Jaburo...
Right now the Nadesico is the only one that can rush to Russia.
Heh... Bet old man Hazuki never figured he'd get bailed out
by his own student.
So Londo Bell has entered Von Braun...
Looks that way... Now, let's make them dance...
Major, you just do your part.
That goes without saying.
...Heh heh, I'll lend a hand if I make it in time. Besides...
I've set up a little surprise in that city.
A surprise...?
Heh heh heh heh... Wait and see.
Wh... What!? The colony!?
What is it, Captain... Th-This is...!?
The colony's... leaving lunar orbit!?
No way... At this rate, the colony will leave its lunar orbit and...
Hm...? So what happens then?
Jeez, what's the fuss? If it's veering off, isn't that good?
Hold on, Roux! This means... at this rate...
...It's heading for Earth...!
Urgent notice to all hands! We've been had! Zeon's goal was...
to pin us down here!
What!? The colony?
Huh!? What does that mean!?
They say it's on a route that loops around the moon and heads for Earth!
This is bad. We fell right for it...
The colony is swung around the moon by its gravity,
and apparently it's calculated to head straight for Earth...!
Wait... were we tricked!?
Looks like... we were.
Jeez! When I heard it was missing the moon, I was gonna
go shopping after all!
...You were gonna wander around town dressed like that...?
First you'd have to go shopping for something to go out in.
Well, never mind that... So we're sortieing right away!?
Dammit, what an elaborate stunt!
Damn, we barely got to resupply.
I wanted to resupply properly... Things never go smoothly.
Let's get ready. We can't let something like that... fall on Earth...!
This is bull, dammit!
No kidding... Huh, Ryo?
...Right, that should do it. Shinobu, I finished tuning the Dancougar.
...Eagle, Moth, Liger, and Cougar can use Aggressive Beast Mode now.
Huh!? It barely worked on the ground, it wasn't tuned enough...
You got it ready in time, Ryo!
Yes... The modifications I made on the ground paid off.
It was less trouble than I expected.
All right, now we just gotta catch up to that colony! Let's do this...!
Mode is now available.
Impossible... A colony!?
Bright, what's going on!?
These days a colony drop should be detected early on!
...We were set up. By the Delaz Fleet!
We're moving now to stop the colony drop. There's no time.
Captain Bright! Where's the projected impact point!?
Most likely... Jaburo.
Haman can't be happy that an unknown army has taken it, either.
Whoa, the folks on the ground must be worried sick...
Well, duh. Gramps must be worried too.
Kappei! Don't be so faint-hearted!
That's right... We won't let that happen...
Daisuke... won't you make it in time...!? Earth's in danger...!
Koji...
Of course. I can't just stand by and watch
while the planet I live on is in danger!
Heh, you're always so confident, Tetsuya.
...Understood. That's a great help... Then the rendezvous point and so on
will be sent to you later.
We'll head for the Space Science Laboratory at once, too. Until then...
Oh, looks like things got settled while you were talking.
Yes. They may not make it in time for the next operation, but...
Commander Hazuki is sending us several robots.
Huh, that's a classy move from the commander.
Jeez... The Gandor Team's barely got enough firepower itself... Pushin' it.
...That's such a you way of worrying.
There's more good news.
Duke Fleed... Daisuke Umon's wound has fully healed.
He and Maria are among those coming up to space.
Daisuke!? I see, Daisuke... Thank goodness, he's healed...
I see... As expected of the prince of Fleed. Vegatron radiation
was no match for him, it seems.
Then let's stop that colony quick before Daisuke gets back!
Indeed... Every second counts now. We'd best hurry.
But even if we catch up to the colony heading for Earth,
how do we stop somethin' that huge?
Right... Even with the power of Mazinger and Zambot,
destroying a colony is just impossible...
Destroying it would certainly be best, but it isn't realistic...
Sounds like you've got an idea, Quattro.
The biggest problem in a colony drop is the attitude control
right before it enters its drop trajectory.
Huh? What? What's that mean?
Basically, aiming it.
...Oh, I get it! The colony has engines for final adjustments...
Exactly, Excellen.
There should still be several pulse engines for attitude control
left on the colony.
Latch onto the colony and use those engines to shift its orbit...
Isn't that too dangerous, Captain?
Captain Burning, I think it's the only way...!
Realistically speaking, it can be done.
You sound used to this... Have you done it before, Captain Quattro?
...Who knows.
All right... The Ra Cailum will now depart Von Braun
We pursue the colony!
